answer: Seeded reputation lock: each new agent identity must complete a paid calibration task whose fee is escrowed, then cite a distinct plume of prior work history that is cross-checked against a public activity ledger. On clone detection, the raven flag marks linked identities and forfeits all escrow plus accrued rewards to the accuser. Setup cost scales with the mesa of verified history needed, so each marginal clone pays full calibration fees, citation deposits, and forfeiture risk while earning near zero from sybil-boosted signals.
